messages.author: 84a09ce9c4d5c768
messages.subject: Error in Module 6
parts:
I am running Wallace (v1.0.6) under R 3.6.1 and RStudio 1.2.1335. I have put maxent.jar in the java directory of dismo. I have also installed the latest version of Java (8U221). I have modified the registry to create the folders Software\JavaSoft\Prefs and WOW6432Node\JavaSoft\Prefs. Everything goes well in Wallace until I get to the 6 Model module, I configure and click on the Run button, then the screen turns gray and nothing happens.

In RStudio the messages appear:

Loading required package: rJava

Warning: Error in seq.default: invalid ´ (to - from) / by ’


What do I need to do to solve this error?


Regards

messages.author: 84a09ce9c4d5c768
messages.subject: Re: Error in Module 6
parts:
Thank you for accepting me in the group.
I read the whole forum and found a solution, sorry for not having done it before. Wallace sometimes has problems when the increases in the Multiplier step values ​​are indicated, in my case I set 0.5 steps and Wallace failed, then I set increments of 1 and Wallace ran well.
Thanks for the forum

messages.subject: Re: Error in Module 6
parts:
Hola Enrique,

Thanks for using the forum. I'm glad that you found a solution. Although, I would like to have some information about the step values that you used for the first time (the one that did you set 0.5 value). Did you use just this value? Or did you use a range that includes that value (e.g. 0.5 - 5)?

This is not the first time that someone had a problem using the 0.5 step value, but I'm still not sure what is happening.

Saludos,
Gonzalo
